name: Social proofs
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site social proof blocks, matched to the live ahaslides.com: Badges (the award row from the footer of the word cloud slide type page) and G2 (the rating row from the hero of the classroom education solutions page). Both are rendered from data files, so a yearly badge refresh or a new rating is a data edit. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Two blocks on one page: Badges and G2, each matched to the live ahaslides.com

Badges: four award badges in a row (G2 Best Software 2026 and the Training Magazine Network Choice Awards 2026), 80px wide with a 12px gap, each linking to the AhaSlides reviews on G2 or its winners page, with the live title, aria-label and alt text
G2: the G2 logo in a white rounded card, then the DS Rate stars filled to the rating, the rating and the review count
Badge and logo images are unaltered third-party marks: never recolour, crop or restyle them
Lists, rating and review count come from marketing/data/social-proofs-badges.json and marketing/data/social-proofs-g2.json, not hand-typed markup
layoutsIntro: Each block copies one social proof row from the live ahaslides.com. Class names carry the block.

layouts.name: Badges
layouts.summary: The award badges row: three G2 Best Software 2026 badges and the Training Magazine Network Choice Awards 2026 badge, each a link, from the footer of the live ahaslides.com.
layouts.useFor: Showing awards and review site recognition in a footer band or below a hero.

layouts.name: G2
layouts.summary: The rating row: the round G2 logo in a white rounded card, the five DS Rate stars filled to the exact rating (the fifth star partly filled for 4.8) with the rating beside them, and the review count underneath, from the hero of the live classroom education page. White by default; the Pale pink state is the surface the pale pink hero sits on, where the white card stands out.
layouts.useFor: Showing an aggregate review rating beside or below a hero call to action.
